description: This file defines a StorageService class responsible for handling file storage operations such as saving uploaded CSV datasets, inspecting CSV files, reading CSV data, and saving result files such as JSON and images. It includes methods for path management and file I/O, with error handling and logging.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A service class for storing and loading dataset files and results, providing methods to save uploads, inspect CSV files, read datasets, and save results in JSON and image formats.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes StorageService with settings obtained from the configuration.

methods.name: str _dataset_path(self, file_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a dataset CSV based on a file ID.

methods.name: str _results_path(self, file_id: str, suffix: str)
methods.description: Constructs the file path for results files with a given suffix based on a file ID.

methods.name: Tuple[str,int,int,bool] save_upload(self, filename: str, file_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded CSV file to disk, inspects it for row and column counts, and header presence, returning metadata.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,bool] _inspect_csv(self, path: str)
methods.description: Reads a CSV file to determine the number of rows, columns, and whether it has a header.

methods.name: Tuple[List[str],List[Dict[str,str]]] read_csv(self, file_id: str)
methods.description: Reads a stored CSV file and returns headers and data rows as dictionaries.

methods.name: str save_results_json(self, file_id: str, name: str, content: str)
methods.description: Saves given JSON content as a results file associated with a file ID.

methods.name: str save_results_image(self, file_id: str, name: str, img_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Saves image bytes as a PNG results file associated with a file ID.
